metaDescription: A 6-minute practice hazard test on AI-generated scenes, in Kerala's announced format, part of a student research project. 18+, anonymous.

landing.h1: Can you spot the hazard in time?
landing.lead: Watch short AI-generated practice scenes and tap when you see a hazard developing. It is a practice test in the format Kerala has announced, not Kerala's test, and it says nothing about how you drive.
landing.fact2: 18 or older, with a learner's licence or a driving licence.
landing.fact3: Anonymous: no name, phone number, licence number, face or location.
landing.fact4: The clips are AI-generated practice scenes: no real people, number plates or places.
landing.sound: No sound needed. Tap anywhere on the clip when you see a hazard developing; tapping too often scores nothing.

counters.none: Live counters appear when the study server is connected. This build has no live data.
counters.collecting: Still collecting: results are published after the pre-registered freeze.
counters.note: Convenience sample, pre-registered before any data. Our AI-generated practice scenes, not Kerala's clips. No crash outcomes are measured.

states.errorTitle: Something went wrong. Your answers so far are kept on this phone.
states.offlineBody: The study needs a connection for this step. Your answers so far are kept.

consent.intro: Nazar is a practice tool and a student research project by team Chanakya for HackCache '26.
consent.p2: We store only: an anonymous ID, age band, licence type, years driving or riding, your quiz and clip scores, and your tap times.
consent.p3: We do not collect your name, phone number, licence number, face or location.
consent.p4: The clips are AI-generated practice scenes, made for this study: no real people, number plates or places appear in them.
consent.p5: Results are for practice only. They say nothing about how you drive, and this is not affiliated with any Motor Vehicles Department, MoRTH or NIC.
consent.p6: Your feedback is written from templates; no AI service receives your answers in this study.
consent.p7: You can delete your data at any time with your anonymous ID.
consent.reviewNote: Hindi text pending review by a native speaker.

declined.line: Nothing was stored. You can still practise hazard spotting on your own, outside the study.

under18.line: The research study is 18+ only, and nothing was stored. You can still practise hazard spotting in the app, with a parent's account in family mode.

bands.lead: Bands only. No name, phone number or email.
bands.missing: Choose one option in each group.

enrolled.keep: Keep it if you may want your data deleted later.
enrolled.mock: Demo mode: this ID and clip set come from this phone, not the study server.
enrolled.plan: Next: 15 quick questions, then 10 clips, a short replay of 2 of them, and 5 new clips.

phase.ll: Part 1 of 3 · 15 questions in the common learner's-licence format
phase.test: Part 2 of 3 · 10 clips in Kerala's announced format
phase.llNote: A fixed study question set, the same for everyone. Not your state's test.

feedback.lead: The striped band is when the hazard was developing; the rings are your taps.
feedback.late: {s} s late ≈ {m} m at {kmh} km/h (estimated speed)
feedback.onTime: Inside the best part of the window.
feedback.early: You tapped just before it started developing: that scores nothing yet.
feedback.placeholder: Placeholder clip (demo mode): the timeline is real, the picture is not.
feedback.none: No replay is available for this session. You can continue.

score.challenge: Can you beat it on the same clips?
score.cardFooter: Not affiliated with any Motor Vehicles Department, MoRTH or NIC.
score.below: Below Kerala's announced 60/100 pass mark, on practice clips.
score.atOrAbove: At or above Kerala's announced 60/100 pass mark, on practice clips.
score.prepost: Per clip, out of 10: {pre} before the replay, {post} on the new clips.
score.provisional: Provisional: computed on this phone. The server's check decides the study score.
score.pending: Your score appears once it's checked.
score.practiceOnly: Practice only, on AI-generated scenes: this says nothing about how you drive.
score.shareText: I scored {score}/100 on a practice hazard-spotting test in Kerala's announced format. Can you beat it on the same clips?
score.shareNote: Shares a link to this study page only: no name, no ID, no score card on a server.

nearMiss.label: Has a near-miss ever happened to you? What happened?
nearMiss.hint: One line, up to 140 characters. No names, phone numbers, vehicle numbers or exact places.
nearMiss.removed: We removed personal details before sending: {kinds}.
nearMiss.sent: Thank you. Your line is stored only in the study table.
nearMiss.refused: The server found personal details (a name, number or exact place). Please describe what happened without them.

done.line: Your anonymous ID is {code}. To delete your data, send this ID to the study lead.
done.debrief: What this measured: how early you noticed hazards developing on our clips. It is practice, not a verdict on your driving.
